question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Extravagant
solution:
The correct answer is **"Frugal."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Extravagant"** means spending money excessively or recklessly. (फ़िजूलख़र्च या बेहद महँगा)

 
 
• **Example**: *He is terribly **extravagant**__.*
 
 
 
• **"Frugal"** is the opposite of **extravagant**.
 
• **"Frugal"** means being economical or thrifty. (केवल उतना ही धन या भोजन का इस्‍तेमाल करते हुए जितना आवश्‍यक हो; कि़फ़ायती, मितव्‍ययी)
 __
 
• **Example**: *He leads a **frugal**__ life.*
 
 

The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: Wicked** means evil or morally wrong. (चरित्रहीन, भ्रष्‍ट; बुरा, दुष्‍ट, पापी)
 
• **Option 3: Mean** means unkind or stingy. (धन आदि स्वयं के लिए रखना न कि दूसरों को देना; कंजूस, स्‍वार्थी)
 
• **Option 4: Wasteful** is a synonym of extravagant. (फ़ज़ूलख़र्च, अपव्‍ययी, उड़ाऊ; ख़र्चीला)
